'''Parwa''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> that was located in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Parwan/Legends|Parwan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Derrown/Legends|Derrown]] originated on Parwa.<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />
